budget_items.what_was_recorded: Warrants and accounts payable were listed by number and date under the minutes item; no vote on them is recorded.
The Devens household hazardous waste program offers collection days at a reasonable fee; no dollar figure is printed.
budget_items.quote: the communities involved can have a household hazardous waste day twice a month for 10 months out of the year at a reasonable fee.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Once a lien is placed the Town is said to be guaranteed payment at a 16% interest rate; foreclosure must go through Land Court.
budget_items.quote: once a lien is placed on a property the town is 100% guaranteed that they will be paid, in time, by the mortgage holder at an interest rate of 16%.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A state grant award of $1.8M was received for the Regional 911 building; a Homeland Security grant application is pending.
budget_items.quote: a grant award was received from the state for the amount of $1.8m.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Lunenburg will receive a net increase of $123,673 in FY2013, offset by increased charges; the increase is spread across all categories.
budget_items.quote: in fy2013 lunenburg will receive a net increase of $123,673.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Chapter 70 aid and General Government aid amounts for FY2013 were reported.
budget_items.quote: chapter 70 money received will be in the amount of $5,691,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Tuition assessments increased significantly, estimated on enrollment and adjusted during the year.
budget_items.quote: the assessments have increased significantly in terms of tuition assessments at $926,658.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Monty Tech will receive additional funding; it may reduce FY2013 assessments or add the money to its excess and deficiency account.
budget_items.quote: ms. speidel stated that monty tech will receive additional funding in the amount of $87,697.
